_comment: 3D assets made with the Meshy API (owner's Pro plan, 2026-10-18). Run: node --env-file=.env tools/art/meshy.mjs [--budget=N] [--only=a,b]. Prompts must stay unbranded: no real brands, logos, agencies, politicians or people.
style: stylized hand-painted game asset, warm Lagos colours, clean readable shapes, no text, no logos, no brand names
character_style: full body game character standing in an A-pose, arms held away from the body, legs apart, facing forward, empty hands, stylized hand-painted look, no text, no logos
